notes: The posted results in doc_registry_NCT01179048.json were searched in outcomeMeasuresModule (all six measures) and adverseEventsModule (event terms and group totals) for adverse events leading to discontinuation, withdrawal, or cessation. They do not report this outcome; Drug withdrawal syndrome is a different event. Table 2 supplies arm ownership, denominators, and the Any adverse event row under Adverse event leading to permanent discontinuation of trial regimen. Other candidates in that section are narrower: serious adverse event (192 versus 245), severe adverse event (164 versus 188), and individual adverse-event types. The overall Any adverse event row (2909 versus 2839) is not restricted to discontinuation and was not selected. All pairs are liraglutide versus placebo.
